nom: DERMA E Vitamin C Even Tone Brightening Mask

avis.texte: 54 yo female here, showing serious signs of skin aging (pale skin, nordic descent) from the texas sun. This mask is a game changer for me. After two uses my fine lines are diminishing and my skin glows. I followed it up with the vitamin e teatree cream and the vitamin c eye stick

avis.titre: The glow will keep you coming back for more!
avis.texte: I used this mask daily on dry clean skin. I've left it on anywhere from 3-10 mins, and the glow is glowing! I'm really impressed by how hydrated my face looks and feels.

1. IT'S PINK. WITH SHIMMER. 2. Delightful application - sort of like getting your face painted at the fair but without all the horror stories of shared sponges 3. The bright, firm feeling it gave my skin skyrocketed my confidence for the day. Oh, and did I mention it's pink? Like Lisa Frank pink? LFG!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This product made my skin very glowy. It is light weight and refreshing

avis.titre: Very Effective and Very metallic dramatic!
avis.texte: Disclaimer: I received this product complimentary for review. The first thing you notice about this Derma E mask is the look—it is bright and very pink and metallic. It really does feel like a party on your face! To be honest, I'm not usually into masks that are this dramatic or visual, but I was pleasantly surprised by the results. The key for me was its exfoliating and smoothing power. After using it, my skin felt exceptionally smooth, and that feeling actually lasted for a few days. While the visual effect might be better suited for a fun summer vibe or a party prep, the actual skincare benefit is definitely there.
I would use this product again. Once I had directions I started right away and I could notice a change in my face right away! I would recommend this product to others.

avis.titre: The vitamin C mask I didn't know I needed in my routine!
avis.texte: I don't usually incorporate a face mask into my skincare routine— usually, I find the application too messy and the results so negligible that it's not even worth the trouble. However, Derma E's brightening Vitamin C mask has more than earned its place in my skincare regimen! The color is gorgeous and the texture is perfect— easy to spread but doesn't slide off as I'm applying. But I think I'm most impressed with the results! After only a couple of uses (I use mine once a week), my skin feels balanced, toned, and clarified (but NOT dry or stripped), and I've definitely noticed some dark spots starting to fade. If you're looking to get your skin soft and glowy in time for summer, this mask is IT!
I love how smooth and bright my skin felt and looked after using the Derma E Vitamin C Tone Brightening Mask!
I've used the product after the shower and it left my skin very soft. No reactions to the mask either.

This mask was like many that I've tried. It's very smooth and cooling when you apply. My skin felt good after I used it. The big flaw-and the reason I probably wouldn't buy it-is that it's really hard to wipe off. I had to put some muscle into getting the pink off.

avis.titre: I will use this product regularly
avis.texte: My skin feels very smooth after using the mask. in order to get the mask completely off my face I had to use a washcloth.

avis.titre: I would not purchase the product.
avis.texte: Dud not see any fading of a specific dark spot on my cheek. Face did feel soft.

avis.titre: My new favorite mask and its not even close
avis.texte: I started out by using the mask once a week, as directed, but eventually I moved up to twice a week because I'm so obsessed with how it makes my skin feel. As soon as I wash off the mask my skin feels so soft and smooth, and it tones down a lot of redness/discoloration I have from acne scarring. I can tell if I upped my usage to 3-4x a week the effects would be even more noticeable. I've also never seen a face mask be such a pretty and dynamic color.

Love the bright pink/gold color of the mask, which makes it a snap to see where you've applied it. The mask itself has a pleasant, smooth texture and is easy to apply. Very little (if any) fragrance, which is always my preference. It took a bit of scrubbing with a washcloth to get it off, which was my only quibble. Once removed, however, my skin was super soft and hydrated - not tight or dry.

avis.titre: I will definitely buy this product again
avis.texte: My skin feels very soft and smooth after using. It was relatively easy to wash off- my only concern is that the pink/red coloring of the mask will stain my white washcloths.

I was really surprised at the color, but thought the bright pink was fun. I was less excited when I took the mask off and my skin was super red and splotchy. While that went away within an hour, I am not sure how often I will be able to use this product. Be careful if you have sensitive skin.

The bright neon pink color of this product is really cool, just not on my skin. When used as instructed I found that not alone did it leave my skin smooth but also a touch pink. I liked it but it did also irritate my acne so I would advise against placing it over any blemish. Again, my skin does feel really soft now though.
I enjoyed an evening face mask! My skin was left glowing after!
This product felt so good putting on my face. It was cool and refreshing. I love the pink sparkly color. After 15 minutes I washed it off and my skin felt so smooth.

I received a sample of this product and used it immediately. My skin felt good and face looked a little bit brighter afterwards, but I found the metallic hot pink color somewhat offputting. Also, as my sample didn't have an ingredient list, I couldn't tell what was causing that coloration.

avis.titre: No for someone with sensitive skin
avis.texte: I was rather shocked by the pinky-gold color of the mask, although it helped you see if you left something on your face. The scent was nice, and it went on easily. However, I have sensitive skin, and after use, my face was beet red for hours afterwards. Others without this issue might have a different experience.
